name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with fingertips beside your head and knees bent to 90 degrees.
Curl your shoulders slightly off the floor.
Straighten one leg forward while turning the opposite elbow toward the bent knee.
Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion.
Keep the shoulders lifted until the set is done.
cues: Turn the shoulder, not just the elbow

common_mistakes.fix: Pause for a moment on each side

common_mistakes.mistake: Pulling the neck forward with the hands
common_mistakes.fix: Keep fingertips light and look slightly up

common_mistakes.mistake: Straight leg dropping so low the back arches
common_mistakes.fix: Extend the leg higher, around 45 degrees
